fonts.heading: "Syncopate", sans-serif (400/700, self-hosted woff2, OFL)
fonts.body: "Instrument Sans", sans-serif (400–700 variable, self-hosted woff2, OFL)

variants.inverse: bg black, text white, p rgba(255,255,255,.85), secondary rgba(255,255,255,.55)

buttons.base: inline-flex, 2px solid border, radius full, heading font sm 700 ls .07em lh 1, padding .75rem 2rem, nowrap; 768: width 100%
buttons.accent: bg amber, text black, shadow 3px 3px 0 black
buttons.heroButton: bg white text black shadow amber
buttons.heroGhost: border rgba(255,255,255,.5) text white shadow black

hero.overlay: .overlay div (rule not in stylesheet match — verify computed)
hero.content: padding-block 4rem, text-shadow 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inner max 52rem, lead max 38rem rgba(255,255,255,.85)

modules.featuredArticle: grid 1fr 1fr gap 3rem; image radius card min-h 20rem (11rem @768); footer border-top gray200 pad-top .75rem flex-end
modules.tabs: menu border-top 2px black pad-top .75rem; link heading xl 700 gray300, active black + 4px amber bottom; pane margin-top 3rem
modules.articleCard: white, 1px gray200, radius card; image 16/10; body flex col gap .75rem pad 1.5rem 1rem
modules.ticker: borders 1px amber, pad-block 1rem; track heading 3xl 700 ls -.02em gap 2rem, animation 40s
modules.faq: item 1px gray200 radius lg mb .75rem; question lg 600 pad 1rem 1.5rem; answer gray700 lh 1.7 collapsed
modules.editorialIndex: grid 5rem 1fr gap 3rem pad-block 2rem border-top amber; number heading 3.5rem 700 ls -.03em amber; 768: 3rem 1fr, 2.5rem
modules.gallery: img h 280px, wide 360px, radius card cover
modules.footer: pad-block 4rem, black, border-top 4px amber, gray500→#999; links sm pad-block .5rem; bottom border-top gray700 pad-top 2rem

tag: inline-flex amber pill, heading .65rem 600 ls .05em, pad .25rem .5rem (+1/-1 top/bottom); tag+heading margin-top 1rem
